name: Way of the Astral Self
description: A monk subclass that adds the Astral Self tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Arms of the Astral Self
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, spend 1 Focus Point to manifest spectral arms for 10 minutes. Their unarmed strikes have extra reach, can use Wisdom, and deal Force damage; their arrival can damage nearby creatures.

grants.name: Forms of Your Astral Self
grants.description: Choose the appearance of your astral form; this is cosmetic and does not change its mechanics.

grants.name: Visage of the Astral Self
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, spend 1 Focus Point to manifest an astral visage for 10 minutes, gaining 120-foot Darkvision, improved Insight and Intimidation, and the ability to project or focus your voice.

grants.name: Body of the Astral Self
grants.description: While your astral arms and visage are active, use your Reaction to reduce elemental damage, and once per turn add one Martial Arts die to damage from the astral arms.

grants.name: Awakened Astral Self
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, spend 5 Focus Points to manifest the complete astral self for 10 minutes. While active, gain +2 AC and make one additional astral-arm attack when using Extra Attack.
